merged_findings.finding: Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) with anterior chest pain and diaphoresis
Primary Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) within 90 minutes reduces 30-day mortality

supporting_evidence.finding: Primary PCI within 90 minutes of medical contact is recommended for acute STEMI
Acute anterior ST elevation correlates with left anterior descending artery occlusion

evidence_priority.finding: Acute STEMI emergency primary PCI protocol

source_traceability.finding: Acute STEMI emergency primary PCI protocol

fusion_summary: Patient presentation and fused clinical findings strongly support acute STEMI requiring emergency primary PCI.
